title: gymnadenia rosellata
intro: Gymnadenia rosellata, commonly known as the Rosy Fingered Orchid, is a species of orchid native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia rosellata include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phenylethanoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
